original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.beacon import emit_beacon
from meta.sas.aggregator import advise_all

def main():
    # Emit simulated Borderline beacon (no sentinel)
    emit_beacon(
        agent="Axiom II",
        state="Borderline",
        tick=287,
        recent_writes_n=0,
        window_ticks=5,
        cooldown_remaining=2,
        path_complexity_est=1.0,
        digestion_intensity=0.2,
        recommended_pace=0.3,
        state_changed=True,
        last_sentinel_tick=280,
        planned_activity=0.1,
        notes="dry-run v0.1 borderline; state_changed=true; sentinel_delta=null"
    )
    # Snapshot advice
    advice = advise_all()
    print(json.dumps(advice, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
